newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Geneva airport says 1996 profits, passengers dip.
newsitem.headline: Geneva airport says 1996 profits, passengers dip.

text.p: Geneva's Cointrin international airport on Thursday reported a sharp drop in profits and a decline in passengers passing through in 1996.
Officials told a news conference net profits had dropped from 8.9 million Swiss francs ($6.1 million) to 3.6 million Swiss francs ($2.46 million).
Passengers totalled 6.18 million, a 1.4 per cent drop on 1995 which was the airport's best year ever with a total of 6.22 million.
Officials blamed the returns partly on a decision by the national airline Swissair to withdraw from the end of October last year most of the long-haul flights it operated out of Geneva.

But they suggested passenger numbers had dipped because the 1995 figure had been inflated by the international telecommunications exhibition, Telecom, held every four years and attracting a growing number of firms and business figures.
